word: Title: Evening At The Art Class
answer: Noche En La Clase De Arte

word: I cut thin strips of paper.
answer: Corto tiras delgadas de papel.

word: You cross the room to grab your brushes. [sing, formal]
answer: Cruza el cuarto para agarrar sus pinceles.

word: We cover the floor with newspaper.
answer: Cubrimos el piso con periódico.

word: They dedicate time to practice shading.
answer: Dedican tiempo a practicar sombras.

word: I define the shape with a light sketch.
answer: Defino la forma con un boceto ligero.

word: You leave your backpack near the door. [sing, inf]
answer: Dejas tu mochila cerca de la puerta.

word: We depend on good lighting.
answer: Dependemos de una buena iluminación.

word: They describe the scene they want to paint.
answer: Describen la escena que quieren pintar.

word: You discover a new color mix. [pl]
answer: Descubren una mezcla de color nueva.

word: We determine the final palette.
answer: Determinamos la paleta final.

word: I cast out the dirty water from the cup.
answer: Echo el agua sucia del vaso.

word: They elaborate a detailed background.
answer: Elaboran un fondo detallado.

word: You use soft strokes for the sky. [sing, formal]
answer: Emplea trazos suaves para el cielo.

word: We confront a challenge with the shadows.
answer: Enfrentamos un reto con las sombras.

word: They show their paintings proudly.
answer: Enseñan sus pinturas con orgullo.

word: I avoid using too much paint.
answer: Evito usar demasiada pintura.

word: You exist in the class list for tonight. [sing, inf]
answer: Existes en la lista de la clase de hoy.

word: We express our ideas about color.
answer: Expresamos nuestras ideas sobre el color.

word: They skip one detail to save time.
answer: Faltan a un detalle para ahorrar tiempo.

word: You post your finished work on the board. [pl]
answer: Fijan su trabajo terminado en el tablero.

word: I sign my name in the corner.
answer: Firmo mi nombre en la esquina.

word: We form a circle to share feedback.
answer: Formamos un círculo para compartir comentarios.

word: They work well with the new brushes.
answer: Funcionan bien con los pinceles nuevos.

word: You win a small applause for your piece. [sing, formal]
answer: Gana un pequeño aplauso por su pieza.

word: I guarantee the next class will be fun.
answer: Garantizo que la próxima clase será divertida.

word: They are going to cover the paintings to dry.
answer: Van a cubrir las pinturas para que se sequen.

word: You are going to describe your process later. [sing, inf]
answer: Vas a describir tu proceso más tarde.

word: We are going to celebrate the finished work.
answer: Vamos a celebrar el trabajo terminado.
